what_the_prior_work_called_it: the primary frame, carrying the D1 and D2 numbers
note: Shipped as RT17_CORE.hmm but byte-identical to B_span17.hmm. The file name and the model name disagree, and every number quoted on RT17_CORE is a number on B_span17.
Registered separately so the identity can be measured rather than asserted.

what_the_prior_work_called_it: the A-lineage counterpart, seeded from the 72 anchors
note: Its seed IS anchors72, so any anchor-based validation in this frame is a self-consistency measurement.
Also the name of a derived column slice in the D3/D7 tables, which is a second object under the same name.
Seeded from 1,500 corpus retrons, so the retron stratum is partly training data in this frame.
